verses.uthmani: طه
verses.indopak: طٰهٰ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ﻿<u>ta</u>h<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Ta, Ha.
verses.khattab: Ṭâ-Hâ
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Tā hā: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Ta ha

verses.uthmani: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: مَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡـنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡـقُرۡاٰنَ لِتَشۡقٰٓى ۙ
verses.transliteration: m<u>a</u> anzaln<u>a</u> 'alayka alqur<u>a</u>na litashq<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
verses.khattab: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We have not revealed the Qur'an to you, O Muhammad (s), that you should be miserable, that you should toil because of what you used to do after it was revealed [to you], in the way of long vigils performing night prayers; in other words, so unburden your soul;
verses.romanUrdu: Humne yeh Quran tumpar is liye nazil nahin kiya hai ke tum museebat mein padh jao

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةً لِّمَنۡ يَّخۡشٰى ۙ
verses.transliteration: ill<u>a</u> ta<u>th</u>kiratan liman yakhsh<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
verses.khattab: but as a reminder to those in awe ˹of Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but, We have revealed it, only to remind, therewith, him who fears, God;
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to ek yaad dihani hai har us shaks ke liye jo darey

verses.uthmani: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.indopak: تَنۡزِيۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ الۡعُلَى ؕ
verses.transliteration: tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati al'ula
verses.saheeh: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
verses.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a revelation (tanzīlan, a substitution, standing in place of the [conjugated] verb [derived] therefrom which renders it [tanzīlan] accusative) from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens (‘ulā, the plural of ‘ulyā, similar [in pattern] to kubrā, kubar, ‘large’);
verses.romanUrdu: Nazil kiya gaya hai us zaat ki taraf se jisne paida kiya hai zameen ko aur buland aasmano ko

verses.uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.indopak: اَلرَّحۡمٰنُ عَلَى الۡعَرۡشِ اسۡتَوٰى
verses.transliteration: alrrahmanu 'ala al'arshi istawa
verses.saheeh: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
verses.khattab: the Most Compassionate, ˹Who is˺ established on the Throne
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He is, the Compassionate One presided upon the Throne (al-‘arsh, in the [classical Arabic] language denotes a king’s seat) a presiding befitting of Him;
verses.romanUrdu: Woh Rehman (qayanaat ke) takht e sultanat par jalwa farma hai

verses.uthmani: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.indopak: لَهٗ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ الثَّرٰى
verses.transliteration: lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara
verses.saheeh: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
verses.khattab: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and whatever is in between and whatever is underground
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and whatever is between them, of creatures, and whatever is beneath the soil (al-tharā, is moist earth) meaning [whatever is beneath] the seven earths, since these lie beneath it.
verses.romanUrdu: Maalik hai un sab cheezon ka jo aasmano aur zameen mein hain aur jo zameen o aasmaan ke darmiyan mein hain aur jo mitti ke nichey hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.indopak: وَاِنۡ تَجۡهَرۡ بِالۡقَوۡلِ فَاِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخۡفٰى
verses.transliteration: wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu ya'lamu alssirra waakhfa
verses.saheeh: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
verses.khattab: Whether you speak openly ˹or not˺, He certainly knows what is secret and what is even more hidden
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And should you be loud in your speech, in remembrance [of God] or supplication, then God has no need for this to be [spoken] loud, then indeed He knows the secret and [that which is] yet more hidden, than that [secret], namely, that which the soul whispers [to itself] and that which occurs to the mind but which you do not speak of [to anyone], so do not strain yourself to be loud [in your speech].
verses.romanUrdu: Tum chahe apni baat pukar kar kaho, woh to chupke se kahi hui baat balke issey makhfi-tar (most secret) baat bhi jaanta hai

verses.uthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.indopak: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ ؕ لَـهُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰى
verses.transliteration: all<u>a</u>hu l<u>a</u> il<u>a</u>ha ill<u>a</u> huwa lahu alasm<u>a</u>o al<u>h</u>usn<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
verses.khattab: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God — there is no god save Him. To Him belong the Most Beautiful Names, the ninety nine [Names], cited in the hadīth (al-husnā is the feminine form of al-ahsan, ‘the best’).
verses.romanUrdu: Woh Allah hai, uske siwa koi khuda nahin, uske liye behtareen naam hain

verses.uthmani: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَهَلۡ اَتٰٮكَ حَدِيۡثُ مُوۡسٰى ۘ
verses.transliteration: wahal at<u>a</u>ka <u>h</u>adeethu moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
verses.khattab: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has the story of Moses — indeed, it has — come to you?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhein kuch Moosa ki khabar bhi pahunchi hai

verses.uthmani: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
verses.indopak: اِذۡ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهۡلِهِ امۡكُثُوۡۤا اِنِّىۡۤ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىۡۤ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوۡ اَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى
verses.transliteration: ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran la'allee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu 'ala alnnari hudan
verses.saheeh: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
verses.khattab: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here, ˹for˺ I have spotted a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it, or find some guidance at the fire.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When he caught sight of a fire and said to his family, namely, to his wife, ‘Wait, here! — this was when he was leaving Midian, heading for Egypt — Indeed I see a fire [in the distance]. Perhaps I [can] bring you a brand from it, [bring you] a burning wick or a torch, or find at the fire some guidance’, that is, someone to guide me by showing me the [proper] route — for he had lost it in the darkness of the night. He [Moses] said, ‘perhaps’ (la‘alla) because he could not be certain of fulfilling his promise.
verses.romanUrdu: Jabke usne ek aag dekhi aur apne ghar walon se kaha ke “ zara thehro, maine ek aag dekhi hai, shayad ke tumhare liye ek-aad angara le aaon, ya is aag par mujhey (raaste ke mutaalik) koi rehnumayi (guidance) mil jaye”

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّاۤ اَتٰٮهَا نُوۡدِىَ يٰمُوۡسٰى ؕ
verses.transliteration: falamm<u>a</u> at<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> noodiya y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
verses.khattab: But when he approached it, he was called, “O Moses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when he reached it — it was a boxthorn — he was called [by name], ‘O Moses!
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan pahuncha to pukara gaya “Aey Moosa

verses.uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
verses.indopak: اِنِّىۡۤ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخۡلَعۡ نَـعۡلَيۡكَ ۚ اِنَّكَ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى ؕ
verses.transliteration: innee ana rabbuka faikhla' na'layka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
verses.khattab: It is truly I. I am your Lord! So take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed (read as innī, if one understands nūdiya, ‘he was called’, as meaning qīla, ‘it was said’; or read it as annī, because of an implied [prefixed] bā’) I am (anā, reiterates the [first person indicator] yā’ [of innī] used by the [direct] speaker) your Lord. So take off your sandals, for lo! you are in the holy, [meaning] either the pure, or the blessed, valley of Tuwā ([this is] either a substitution, or an explicative supplement; read [Tuwan] with nunation or [Tuwā] without: it is [considered] declinable on account of it being a location; but [alternatively considered] indeclinable, if taken as considered a feminine proper noun denoting a place name).
verses.romanUrdu: Main hi tera Rubb hoon, jutiyan (shoes) utaar de, tu waadi e muqaddas Tuwa mein hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَاَنَا اخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَاسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوۡحٰى
verses.transliteration: waana ikhtartuka faistami' lima yooha
verses.saheeh: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
verses.khattab: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And I [Myself] have chosen you, from among [all of] your people, so listen to what is being revealed, to you from Me.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur maine tujhko chun liya hai, sun jo kuch wahee kiya jata hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.indopak: اِنَّنِىۡۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدۡنِىۡ ۙ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكۡرِىۡ
verses.transliteration: innanee ana allahu la ilaha illa ana fao'budnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
verses.khattab: ‘It is truly I. I am Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me. So worship Me ˹alone˺, and establish prayer for My remembrance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily I am God — there is no god except Me. So worship Me and establish prayer for to make remembrance of Me, in it.
verses.romanUrdu: Main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa koi khuda nahin hai, pas tu meri bandagi kar aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَـةٌ اَكَادُ اُخۡفِيۡهَا لِتُجۡزٰى كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۢ بِمَا تَسۡعٰى
verses.transliteration: inna alssa'ata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tas'a
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
verses.khattab: The Hour is sure to come. My Will is to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded according to their efforts
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Hour is assuredly coming. [But] I will to keep it hidden, from mankind — and its nearness [in time] will manifest itself to them through its signs — so that every soul may be requited, thereupon, for what it strives for, of good or evil.
verses.romanUrdu: Qayamat ki ghadi zaroor aane wali hai, main uska waqt makhfi rakhna chahta hoon, taa-ke har mutanaffis apni saii(labours/koshish) ke mutabik badla paye

verses.uthmani: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَنۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰٮهُ فَتَرۡدٰى
verses.transliteration: fala yasuddannaka 'anha man la yuminu biha waittaba'a hawahu fatarda
verses.saheeh: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
verses.khattab: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it, or you will be doomed.’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So do not let him bar you, distract you, from it, that is, from believing in it, who believes not in it but follows his own whim, in denying [the truth of] it, lest you perish, that is, lest you be ruined if you are barred from [remembering] it.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas koi aisa shaks jo uspar iman nahin laata aur apni khwahish e nafs ka banda ban gaya hai tujhko us ghadi ki fikr se na roak de, warna tu halakat mein padh jayega

verses.uthmani: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِيۡنِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: wam<u>a</u> tilka biyameenika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
verses.khattab: ˹Allah added,˺ “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And what is that, that happens to be, in your right hand, O Moses?’ (the interrogative is meant as an affirmative, [but it is expressed as an interrogative] in order that the miracle [to be manifested] in it be [shown as] consequent upon it).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aey Moosa, yeh tere haath mein kya hai?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ ۚ اَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَيۡهَا وَاَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰى غَـنَمِىۡ وَلِىَ فِيۡهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخۡرٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la hiya 'a<u>sa</u>ya atawakkao 'alayh<u>a</u> waahushshu bih<u>a</u> 'al<u>a</u> ghanamee waliya feeh<u>a</u> ma<u>a</u>ribu okhr<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
verses.khattab: He replied, “It is my staff! I lean on it, and with it I beat down ˹branches˺ for my sheep, and have other uses for it.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘It is my staff. I lean, I support myself, upon it, when I leap [across something] or walk, and I beat down [leaves], I strike the leaves on trees, with it, so that they fall, for my sheep, which then consume them; and I have uses for it (ma’ārib, ‘uses’, is the plural of ma’ruba, with the rā’ taking any [one] of the three vowels [sc. ma’ruba, ma’raba or ma’riba] meaning ‘needs’) in other ways, such as [using it] to carry food supplies and waterskins, as well as to drive away [undesirable] animals. He [Moses] gives an extensive response to indicate his [many] needs for it.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne jawab diya “yeh meri laathi hai, ispar taik laga kar chalta hoon, issey apni bakriyon ke liye pattey jhadta hoon, aur bhi bahut se kaam hain jo issey leta hoon”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اَلۡقِهَا يٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la alqih<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
verses.khattab: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Cast it down, O Moses!’
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “phenk de isko Moosa”

verses.uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَاَلۡقٰٮهَا فَاِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسۡعٰى
verses.transliteration: faalq<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> fai<u>tha</u> hiya <u>h</u>ayyatun tas'<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
verses.khattab: So he did, then—behold!—it became a serpent, slithering
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, a giant snake, moving swiftly, moving about on its belly swiftly with the speed of a small snake — which is called al-jānn and which is [also] used to refer to this [serpent] in another verse [Q. 27:10; Q. 28:31].
verses.romanUrdu: Usne phenk diya aur yakayak woh ek saanp (snake) thi jo daud raha tha

verses.uthmani: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡ سَنُعِيۡدُهَا سِيۡرَتَهَا الۡاُوۡلٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la khu<u>th</u>h<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> takhaf sanu'eeduh<u>a</u> seeratah<u>a</u> alool<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
verses.khattab: Allah said, “Take it, and have no fear. We will return it to its former state
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Take [hold of] it and do not fear, it. We will restore it to its former state (sīratahā, in the accusative because the genitive-operating preposition has been removed). And so he placed his hand in its mouth and it became a staff once again; and it became clear that the place into which he put his hand was the place where it [the staff] is held, between its two prongs. Moses was shown this [miracle] lest he be terrified when it turns into a snake in the presence of Pharaoh.
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “pakad le isko aur darr nahin, hum isey phir waisa hi kardenge jaisi yeh thi

verses.uthmani: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَاضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ اِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍ اٰيَةً اُخۡرٰى ۙ
verses.transliteration: waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra
verses.saheeh: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
verses.khattab: And put your hand under your armpit, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished, as another sign
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And thrust your hand, the right one, meaning, the palm, into your flank — that is, your left side, below the arm into the armpit, and [then] take it out — it will emerge white, in contrast to the skin-colour that it was, without any fault, that is, [without any sign of] leprosy, radiating like the rays of the sun, blinding to the eyes [of onlookers]. [That is] yet another sign (āyatan ukhrā: this together with baydā’a, ‘white’, constitute two circumstantial qualifiers referring to the subject of [the verb] takhruj, ‘it will emerge’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zara apna haath apni bagal mein daba, chamakta hua niklega bagair kisi takleef ke, yeh dusri nishani hai

verses.uthmani: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.indopak: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا الۡـكُبۡـرٰى ۚ
verses.transliteration: linuriyaka min <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tin<u>a</u> alkubr<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
verses.khattab: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That We may show you, thereby, when you do this [as described above] in order to manifest it, of Our greatest signs, the sign that is the greatest proof of [the truth of] your Mission [from God]: and should he want it to be restored to its former state, he would thrust it into his armpit, as has been mentioned, and [then] bring it out.
verses.romanUrdu: Is liye ke hum tujhey apni badi nishniyan dikane waley hain

verses.uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِذۡهَبۡ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰى
verses.transliteration: i<u>th</u>hab il<u>a</u> fir'awna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
verses.khattab: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Go, as a messenger [from God], to Pharaoh, and [to] those with him. He has indeed transgressed’, he has exceeded the [usual] limits in his disbelief by claiming to be a god.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab tu Firoun ke paas jaa, woh sarkash ho gaya hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِىۡ صَدۡرِىْ ۙ
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la rabbi ishra<u>h</u> lee <u>s</u>adree
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
verses.khattab: Moses prayed, “My Lord! Uplift my heart for me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘My Lord, expand my breast for me, expand it so that it may accommodate the [weight of the Divine] Message.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne arz kiya “ parwardigar, mera seena khol de

verses.uthmani: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.indopak: وَيَسِّرۡ لِىۡۤ اَمۡرِىْ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wayassir lee amree
verses.saheeh: And ease for me my task
verses.khattab: and make my task easy
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And make easy, facilitate, for me my affair, that I may deliver it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur mere kaam ko mere liye aasaan karde

verses.uthmani: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.indopak: وَاحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً مِّنۡ لِّسَانِیْ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waohlul 'uqdatan min lisanee
verses.saheeh: And untie the knot from my tongue
verses.khattab: and remove the impediment from my tongue
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And undo the knot upon my tongue — the result of his having been burnt by a live coal which he had placed [accidentally] in his mouth as a child;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur meri zubaan ki girah suljha de

verses.uthmani: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.indopak: يَفۡقَهُوۡا قَوۡلِیْ
verses.transliteration: yafqahoo qawlee
verses.saheeh: That they may understand my speech.
verses.khattab: so people may understand my speech
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that they may understand what I [shall] say, when I am delivering the Message.
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke log meri baat samajh sakein

verses.uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.indopak: وَاجۡعَلْ لِّىۡ وَزِيۡرًا مِّنۡ اَهۡلِىْ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waij'al lee wazeeran min ahlee
verses.saheeh: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
verses.khattab: and grant me a helper from my family
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And appoint for me a minister, an assistant for that [task], from my family,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur mere liye mere apne kumbe (my own family) se ek wazir muqarrar karde

verses.uthmani: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.indopak: هٰرُوۡنَ اَخِى ۙ
verses.transliteration: h<u>a</u>roona akhee
verses.saheeh: Aaron, my brother.
verses.khattab: Aaron, my brother
verses.jalalayn: Aaron (Haruna, constitutes the second object), my brother (akhi, an explicative supplement).
verses.romanUrdu: Haroon, jo mera bhai hai

verses.uthmani: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.indopak: اشۡدُدۡ بِهٖۤ اَزۡرِىْ ۙ
verses.transliteration: oshdud bihi azree
verses.saheeh: Increase through him my strength
verses.khattab: Strengthen me through him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Confirm through him my strength, my courage;
verses.romanUrdu: Uske zariye se mera haath mazboot kar

verses.uthmani: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.indopak: وَاَشۡرِكۡهُ فِىۡۤ اَمۡرِىْ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waashrikhu fee amree
verses.saheeh: And let him share my task
verses.khattab: and let him share my task
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and let him share in my affair, namely, in [the delivery of] the Message (both verbs [ushdud, ‘confirm’, and ashrikhu, ‘let him share’] are in the imperative and in the apocopated imperfect tense, constituting the response to the request [of Moses]).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usko mere kaam mein shareek karde

verses.uthmani: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
verses.indopak: كَىۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيۡرًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: kay nusabbihaka katheeran
verses.saheeh: That we may exalt You much
verses.khattab: so that we may glorify You much
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So that we may glorify You, [by making] glorifications, over and over again,
verses.romanUrdu: Hum khoob teri paaki bayan karein

verses.uthmani: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.indopak: وَّنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيۡرًا ؕ
verses.transliteration: wanathkuraka katheeran
verses.saheeh: And remember You much.
verses.khattab: and remember You much
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and remember You, [by making] remembrance, over and over again.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur khoob tera charcha karein

verses.uthmani: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
verses.indopak: اِنَّكَ كُنۡتَ بِنَا بَصِيۡرًا
verses.transliteration: innaka kunta bina baseeran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
verses.khattab: for truly You have ˹always˺ been overseeing us.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed You are ever Seeing of us’, ever Knowing, having been gracious [to us] by way of [appointing us to deliver] the Message.
verses.romanUrdu: Tu hamesha hamare haal par nigraan raha hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ قَدۡ اُوۡتِيۡتَ سُؤۡلَـكَ يٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la qad ooteeta sulaka y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
verses.khattab: Allah responded, “All that you requested has been granted, O Moses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘You have been granted your request, O Moses!, as a favour [from Us] to you.
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “ diya gaya jo tu nay maanga aey Moosa

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ مَنَـنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً اُخۡرٰٓى ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad manann<u>a</u> 'alayka marratan okhr<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
verses.khattab: And surely We had shown You favour before
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And certainly, We have done you a favour [already] another time,
verses.romanUrdu: Humne phir ek martaba tujhpar ehsan kiya

verses.uthmani: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: اِذۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰٓى اُمِّكَ مَا يُوۡحٰٓى ۙ
verses.transliteration: i<u>th</u> aw<u>h</u>ayn<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> ommika m<u>a</u> yoo<u>ha</u>
verses.saheeh: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
verses.khattab: when We inspired your mother with this
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when (idh, for explanation [of that favour]) We revealed to your mother, either in [her] sleep or by way of inspiration — when she gave birth to you and feared that Pharaoh would have you slain for being one of the newborn [of the Children of Israel] — that which was revealed, regarding your affair (this [mā yūhā, ‘that which was revealed’] is substituted by [what follows, an iqdhifīhi …]),
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo woh waqt jabke humne teri Maa ko ishara kiya, aisa ishara jo wahee ke zariye kiya jaata hai

verses.uthmani: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.indopak: اَنِ اقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِى التَّابُوۡتِ فَاقۡذِفِيۡهِ فِى الۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ الۡيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَاۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّىۡ وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهٗ ؕ وَاَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَـبَّةً مِّنِّىۡ ۚ وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلٰى عَيۡنِىۡ ۘ
verses.transliteration: ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu 'aduwwun lee wa'aduwwun lahu waalqaytu 'alayka mahabbatan minnee walitusna'a 'ala 'aynee
verses.saheeh: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
verses.khattab: ‘Put him into a chest, then put it into the river. The river will wash it ashore, and he will be taken by ˹Pharaoh,˺ an enemy of Mine and his.’ And I blessed you with lovability from Me ˹O Moses˺ so that you would be brought up under My ˹watchful˺ Eye
verses.jalalayn: ﻿“Cast him, place him, in the ark, then cast him, [while] in the ark, into the river, [into] the flow of the Nile, and then the river shall throw him up onto the shore, that is, its bank (the imperative here [fa’l-yulqihi, ‘let it throw him’] functions as a predicate); [there] an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his, namely, Pharaoh, shall take him”. And, after he took you, I cast upon you love from Me, that you may be loved by people; and indeed Pharaoh, and all who saw you, loved you; and that you might be reared under My eyes, be nurtured under My guardianship and My protection of you.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke is bacchey ko sandook (box) mein rakh de aur sandook ko dariya mein chodh de, dariya isey saahil par phenk dega aur isey mera dushman aur is bacchey ka dushman utha lega. Maine apni taraf se tujhpar mohabbat taari kardi aur aisa intizam kiya ke tu meri nigrani mein paala jaye

wbw.translation: and that you may be brought up

verses.uthmani: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِذۡ تَمۡشِىۡۤ اُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُوۡلُ هَلۡ اَدُلُّـكُمۡ عَلٰى مَنۡ يَّكۡفُلُهٗ ؕ فَرَجَعۡنٰكَ اِلٰٓى اُمِّكَ كَىۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ ؕ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَـفۡسًا فَنَجَّيۡنٰكَ مِنَ الۡغَمِّ وَفَتَـنّٰكَ فُتُوۡنًا فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِيۡنَ فِىۡۤ اَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ۙ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلٰى قَدَرٍ يّٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: i<u>th</u> tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'al<u>a</u> man yakfuluhu faraja'n<u>a</u>ka il<u>a</u> ommika kay taqarra 'aynuh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ta<u>h</u>zana waqatalta nafsan fanajjayn<u>a</u>ka mina alghammi wafatann<u>a</u>ka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita 'al<u>a</u> qadarin y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when your sister came along and proposed, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will nurse him?’ So We reunited you with your mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and she would not grieve. ˹Later˺ you killed a man ˹by mistake˺, but We saved you from sorrow, as well as other tests We put you through. Then you stayed for a number of years among the people of Midian. Then you came here as pre-destined, O Moses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When (idh, for explanation) your sister, Maryam, walked up, to obtain news of you, for they had brought wet nurses [for you] but you would not take to the breast of any of them, and she then said, “Shall I show you someone who will take care of him?”. Her offer was accepted and so she brought [them] his mother and he took to her breasts. Thus We restored you to your mother that her eyes might rejoice, in seeing you again, and not grieve, at that point [anymore]. Then you slew a soul, namely, the Copt in Egypt — and you became distressed for having slain him because of [how] Pharaoh [would react]; whereupon We delivered you from [great] distress, and We tried you with various ordeals, We tested you by landing you in some other [ordeal] and [again] delivered you from it. Then you stayed for several years, ten [years], among the people of Midian, after you had reached it having left Egypt, [staying] with the prophet Shu‘ayb and marrying his daughter. Then you came [hither] as ordained, in My knowledge, with the Message [that you will deliver] — and this was when you were forty years old, O Moses!
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad kar jabke teri behan chal rahi thi, phir jaa kar kehti hai, “main tumhein uska pata doon jo is bacchey ki parwarish acchi tarah karey?” Is tarah humne tujhey phir teri Maa ke paas pahuncha diya taa-ke uski aankh thandi rahey aur woh ranjeeda na ho. Aur (yeh bhi yaad kar ke) tu nay ek shaks ko qatal kardiya tha, humne tujhey is phanday se nikala aur tujhey mukhtalif aazmaaishon se guzara aur tu Madiyan ke logon mein kai saal thehra raha. Phir ab theek apne waqt par tu aa gaya hai aey Moosa

verses.uthmani: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.indopak: وَاصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِى ۚ
verses.transliteration: waistana'tuka linafsee
verses.saheeh: And I produced you for Myself.
verses.khattab: And I have selected you for My service
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And I chose you for Myself, to deliver the Message.
verses.romanUrdu: Maine tujhey apne kaam ka bana liya hai

verses.uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.indopak: اِذۡهَبۡ اَنۡتَ وَاَخُوۡكَ بِاٰيٰتِىۡ وَلَا تَنِيَا فِىۡ ذِكۡرِى ۚ
verses.transliteration: i<u>th</u>hab anta waakhooka bi<u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tee wal<u>a</u> taniy<u>a</u> fee <u>th</u>ikree
verses.saheeh: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
verses.khattab: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs and never falter in remembering Me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Go, you and your brother, to the people, with My, nine, signs, and do not flag, be remiss, in remembrance of Me, by uttering glorifications and otherwise.
verses.romanUrdu: Ja, tu aur tera bhai meri nishaniyon ke saath, aur dekho tum meri yaad mein taqseer (susti /negligence) na karna

verses.uthmani: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِذۡهَبَاۤ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰى ۖ ۚ
verses.transliteration: i<u>th</u>hab<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> fir'awna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.khattab: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Go the two of you to Pharaoh. Truly he has transgressed [the bounds], in claiming to be the Lord.
verses.romanUrdu: Jao tum dono Firoun ke paas ke woh sarkash ho gaya hai

verses.uthmani: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَقُوۡلَا لَهٗ قَوۡلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ يَتَذَكَّرُ اَوۡ يَخۡشٰى
verses.transliteration: faqool<u>a</u> lahu qawlan layyinan la'allahu yata<u>th</u>akkaru aw yakhsh<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."
verses.khattab: Speak to him gently, so perhaps he may be mindful ˹of Me˺ or fearful ˹of My punishment˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And speak to him gentle words, for him to renounce such [claims], that perhaps he may be mindful, be admonished, or fear’, God and so repent — the ‘hope’ [for Pharaoh’s repentance] is [expressed] from their perspective, for God knows that he was not going to repent.
verses.romanUrdu: Ussey narmi ke saath baat karna, shayad ke woh naseehat qabool karey ya darr jaaye”

verses.uthmani: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَا رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّـنَا نَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَاۤ اَوۡ اَنۡ يَّطۡغٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>l<u>a</u> rabban<u>a</u> innan<u>a</u> nakh<u>a</u>fu an yafru<u>t</u>a 'alayn<u>a</u> aw an ya<u>t</u>gh<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
verses.khattab: They both pleaded, “Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The two [of them] said, ‘Our Lord, We truly fear that he may forestall us, that is, by hastening to punish us, or become tyrannical’, against us, that is, be high-handed [with us].
verses.romanUrdu: Dono ne arz kiya “ parwardigar, humein andesha hai ke woh humpar zyadati karega ya pil padega(treat us cruelly)”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ اِنَّنِىۡ مَعَكُمَاۤ اَسۡمَعُ وَاَرٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la l<u>a</u> takh<u>a</u>f<u>a</u> innanee ma'akum<u>a</u> asma'u waar<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
verses.khattab: Allah reassured ˹them˺, “Have no fear! I am with you, hearing and seeing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Do not fear, for I shall be with the two of you, by [providing you with] My assistance, hearing, what he says, and seeing, what he does.
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya” daro mat, main tumhare saath hoon, sab kuch sun raha hoon aur dekh raha hoon

verses.uthmani: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: فَاۡتِيٰهُ فَقُوۡلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ ۙ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡ ؕ قَدۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ ؕ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلٰى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الۡهُدٰى
verses.transliteration: fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil ma'ana banee israeela wala tu'aththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu 'ala mani ittaba'a alhuda
verses.saheeh: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
verses.khattab: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed we are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And salvation will be for whoever follows the ˹right˺ guidance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So go to him and say, “Truly we are two messengers of your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, to Syria, and do not [continue to] chastise them, in other words, release them from your exploitation of them in those oppressive works of yours, such as digging, construction and the lifting of heavy objects. We have verily brought you a sign, a definitive argument, from your Lord, as proof of our truthfulness in [delivering] the Message; and may peace be upon him who follows [right] guidance, that is to say, may he be secure from [God’s] chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Jao uske paas aur kaho ke hum tere Rubb ke faristaade (messengers) hain, bani Israel ko hamare saath janey ke liye chodh de aur unko takleef na de. Hum tere paas tere Rubb ki nishani lekar aaye hain aur salamati hai uske liye jo raah-e-raast ki pairwi karey

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا قَدۡ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَـيۡنَاۤ اَنَّ الۡعَذَابَ عَلٰى مَنۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰى
verses.transliteration: inn<u>a</u> qad oo<u>h</u>iya ilayn<u>a</u> anna al'a<u>tha</u>ba 'al<u>a</u> man ka<u>thth</u>aba watawall<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
verses.khattab: It has indeed been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies ˹the truth˺ and turns away.’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed it has been revealed to us that the chastisement shall befall him who denies, [the truth of] what we have brought, and turns away” ’, [and who] rejects it. And so they came to him and said [to him] all of what has been mentioned.
verses.romanUrdu: Humko wahee (revelation) se bataya gaya hai ke azaab hai uske liye jo jhutlaye aur mooh moadey.”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَمَنۡ رَّبُّكُمَا يٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la faman rabbukum<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
verses.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘So who is your Lord, O Moses?’ — he [Pharaoh] restricted this [question] to him [Moses], because [between him and Aaron] he is the principal [bearer of God’s Message] and also because of his [Pharaoh’s] having pampered him while he was being reared [as a child].
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “accha, to phir tum dono ka Rubb kaun hai aey Moosa?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِىۡۤ اَعۡطٰـى كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ خَلۡقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la rabbun<u>a</u> alla<u>th</u>ee a'<u>ta</u> kulla shayin khalqahu thumma had<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
verses.khattab: He answered, “Our Lord is the One Who has given everything its ˹distinctive˺ form, then guided ˹it˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Our Lord is He Who gave to everything, in creation, its [peculiar] nature, through which it is distinguished from another [thing], and then guided [it]’, the animal among them to its source of food, drink and procreation and in other ways.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne jawab diya “hamara Rubb woh hai jisne har cheez ko uski saakht bakshi(given distinctive form), phir usko raasta bataya”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الۡقُرُوۡنِ الۡاُوۡلٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la fam<u>a</u> b<u>a</u>lu alqurooni alool<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
verses.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “And what about previous peoples?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Pharaoh, said, ‘So what of, the status [of], the generations, the communities, of old?’, such as the people of Noah, Hūd, Lot and Sālih, with regard to their having worshipped graven images.
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun bola “aur pehle jo nasalein (generations) guzar chuki hain unki phir kya halat thi?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.indopak: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ رَبِّىۡ فِىۡ كِتٰبٍ ۚ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّىۡ وَلَا يَنۡسَى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la 'ilmuh<u>a</u> 'inda rabbee fee kit<u>a</u>bin l<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>illu rabbee wal<u>a</u> yans<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
verses.khattab: He replied, “That knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither falters nor forgets ˹anything˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said he, Moses, ‘The knowledge thereof, that is, the knowledge of their [otherworldly] status, is, preserved, with my Lord, in a Book, namely, the Preserved Tablet (al-lawh al-mahfūz), and He shall requite them in accordance with it on the Day of Resurrection. My Lord does not err, He is [never] absent from anything, nor does He, my Lord, forget, anything.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “uska ilam mere Rubb ke paas ek nawishte (record) mein mehfooz hai, mera Rub na chukta hai na bhoolta hai”

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
verses.indopak: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّسَلَكَ لَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا وَّ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً ؕ فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهٖۤ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰى
verses.transliteration: allathee ja'ala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta
verses.saheeh: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
verses.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for ˹all of˺ you, and set in it pathways for you, and sends down rain from the sky, causing various types of plants to grow
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He is, the One Who made for you, as well as [for] all creatures, the earth a cradle, a bed, and threaded, facilitated, for you therein ways, roads, and sent down from the heaven water, rain. God, exalted be He, says, as a complement to Moses’s description of Him and as an address to the people of Mecca: and therewith We brought forth various kinds, species, of plants (shattā, ‘various’, adjectivally qualifies azwājan, ‘kinds’), in other words, [plants] of different colours, flavours and [different] in other ways (shattā is the plural of shatīt, similar [in pattern] to marīd, [plural] mardā, as [may be used] in [a phrase like] shatta al-amr, ‘the affair has become divided’).
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi jisne tumhare liye zameen ka farsh bichaya, aur usmein tumhare chalne ko raaste banaye, aur upar se pani barsaya, phir uske zariye se mukhtalif aqsam ki paidawaar nikali

verses.uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.indopak: كُلُوۡا وَارۡعَوۡا اَنۡعَامَكُمۡ ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰ لِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِى الـنُّهٰى
verses.transliteration: kuloo wair'aw an'amakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
verses.saheeh: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.khattab: ˹so˺ eat and graze your cattle. Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Eat, thereof, and pasture your cattle, therein (an‘ām, ‘cattle’, is the plural of na‘am, which are camels, cows and sheep; one says ra‘atu’l-an‘āmu, ‘the cattle grazed’ or ra‘aytuhā, ‘I grazed them’; the imperative here is meant as a permissive and a reminder of [God’s] grace, the sentence being a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of [the verb] akhrajnā, ‘We brought forth’, in other words [what is meant is], ‘[We brought forth the plants] permitting you to eat thereof and to graze [your] cattle [thereon]’). In that, which is mentioned here, there are indeed signs, indeed lessons, for people of sense, possessors of intellect (al-nuhā, the plural of nuhya, similar [in pattern] to ghurfa, [plural] ghuraf. The intellect is called by this [term, nuhya] because it shows a person the sense to refrain from committing vile deeds).
verses.romanUrdu: Khao aur apne jaanwaron ko bhi charao, yaqeenan is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain aqal rakhne walon ke liye

verses.uthmani: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.indopak: مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَفِيۡهَا نُعِيۡدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً اُخۡرٰى
verses.transliteration: minh<u>a</u> khalaqn<u>a</u>kum wafeeh<u>a</u> nu'eedukum waminh<u>a</u> nukhrijukum t<u>a</u>ratan okhr<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
verses.khattab: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you back again
verses.jalalayn: ﻿From it, that is, from the earth, We created you, by creating your father Adam from it, and into it We shall restore you, [when you are] interred after death, and from it We shall bring you forth, at the Resurrection, a second time’, in the same way that We brought you forth [from it] when We initiated your creation.
verses.romanUrdu: Isi zameen se humne tumko paida kiya hai, isi mein hum tumhein wapas le jayenge aur isi se tumko dobara nikalenge

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَلَـقَدۡ اَرَيۡنٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَاَبٰى
verses.transliteration: walaqad arayn<u>a</u>hu <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tin<u>a</u> kullah<u>a</u> faka<u>thth</u>aba waab<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
verses.khattab: And We certainly showed Pharaoh all of Our signs, but he denied them and refused ˹to believe˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We showed him, that is, We made Pharaoh see, all Our signs, [all] nine, but he denied, them, and claimed that they were [the result of] sorcery, and refused, to affirm the Oneness [of God], exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Firoun ko apni sabhi nishaniyan dikayi magar woh jhutlaye chala gaya aur na maana

verses.uthmani: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ اَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la ajitan<u>a</u> litukhrijan<u>a</u> min ar<u>d</u>in<u>a</u> bisi<u>h</u>rika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
verses.khattab: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Have you come to us so that you may expel us from our land, Egypt, and so that kingship over it may be yours, by your sorcery, O Moses?
verses.romanUrdu: Kehne laga “aey Moosa, kya tu hamare paas is liye aaya hai ke apne jaadu ke zoar se humko hamare mulk se nikal bahar karey

verses.uthmani: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
verses.indopak: فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ فَاجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدًا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهٗ نَحۡنُ وَلَاۤ اَنۡتَ مَكَانًـا سُوًى
verses.transliteration: falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faij'al baynana wabaynaka maw'idan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan
verses.saheeh: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
verses.khattab: We can surely meet you with similar magic. So set for us an appointment that neither of us will fail to keep, in a central place.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Yet We [too] shall produce for you a sorcery like it, [one] which will counter it. So fix a tryst between us and you, for that [purpose], [a tryst] which neither we nor you shall fail to keep, [at] a place (makānan is in the accusative because the genitive-operator preposition [fī, ‘at’] has been removed) of equal distance (read siwān or suwān), in other words, in the middle, equidistant for a person coming from either side.
verses.romanUrdu: Accha, hum bhi tere muqable mein waisa hi jaadu latey hain, tai karle kab aur kahan muqaabla karna hai, na hum is qarardaad se phirenge na tu Phiriyo , khule maidan mein saamne aaja”

wbw.translation: Then we will surely produce for you

verses.uthmani: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
verses.indopak: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ الزِّيۡنَةِ وَاَنۡ يُّحۡشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى
verses.transliteration: qala maw'idukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan
verses.saheeh: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
verses.khattab: Moses said, “Your appointment is on the Day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered mid-morning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said he, Moses, ‘Your tryst shall be the Day of Adornment — a festive day of theirs on which they adorn themselves and [the public] assemble — and let the people assemble, [let] the inhabitants of Egypt gather, at forenoon’, the time for this [tryst], to observe what will transpire.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “jashn ka din tai hua, aur din chadhey log jama hon”

verses.uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَتَوَلّٰى فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰى
verses.transliteration: fatawall<u>a</u> fir'awnu fajama'a kaydahu thumma at<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
verses.khattab: Pharaoh then withdrew, orchestrated his scheme, then returned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then Pharaoh withdrew, retreated, and summoned up his guile, that is to say, those [human] elements of his guile from among the sorcerers, and then came, with them to the tryst.
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne palat kar apne saare hathkande jama kiye aur muqaable mein aa gaya

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰى وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُوۡا عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسۡحِتَكُمۡ بِعَذَابٍ ۚ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ افۡتَرٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la lahum moos<u>a</u> waylakum l<u>a</u> taftaroo 'al<u>a</u> all<u>a</u>hi ka<u>th</u>iban fayus<u>h</u>itakum bi'a<u>tha</u>bin waqad kh<u>a</u>ba mani iftar<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
verses.khattab: Moses warned the magicians, “Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, or He will wipe you out with a torment. Whoever fabricates ˹lies˺ is bound to fail.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Moses said to them — and there were 72 of them, each with a rope and a staff in his hand — ‘Woe to you!, meaning, may God make you liable to woe. Do not invent a lie against God, by ascribing partners to Him, lest He annihilate you (read fa-yushitakum or fa-yashatakum) by some chastisement, from Him. For verily he who invents lies, against God, fails’, [he] is the loser.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne ( ain mauqe par giroh muqabil ko mukhatib karke) kaha “shamat ke maaron, na jhooti tohmatein (invent falsehood) baandho Allah par, warna woh ek sakht azaab se tumhara sattyanaas kardega, jhoot jisne bhi ghada woh na-murad hua”

verses.uthmani: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَتَنَازَعُوۡۤا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوٰى
verses.transliteration: fatanaza'oo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa
verses.saheeh: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
verses.khattab: So the magicians disputed the matter among themselves, conversing privately
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So they disputed their matter among themselves, regarding Moses and his brother, and kept secret their private counsel, that is, their conversation regarding the two,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh sunkar unke darmiyan ikhtilaf e raai ho gaya aur woh chupke chupke baham mashwarey karne lagey

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡۤا اِنۡ هٰذٰٮنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُرِيۡدٰنِ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيۡقَتِكُمُ الۡمُثۡلٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>loo in h<u>atha</u>ni las<u>ah</u>ir<u>a</u>ni yureed<u>a</u>ni an yukhrij<u>a</u>kum min ar<u>d</u>ikum bisi<u>h</u>rihim<u>a</u> waya<u>th</u>hab<u>a</u> bi<u>t</u>areeqatikumu almuthl<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
verses.khattab: They concluded, “These two are only magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and do away with your most cherished traditions
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, to each other, ‘These two men (hādhān, this [form] concords with the forms used by those [grammarians] who use the alif [ending] for all three cases of the dual person; Abū ‘Amr has [the variant reading] hādhayn) are indeed sorcerers who intend to expel you from your land by their sorcery, and do away with your excellent traditions (muthlā, the feminine form of amthal, meaning ‘the noblest’) in other words, [they will do away with the loyalty of] the noblemen among you, because these [latter] will prefer the two of them [Moses and Aaron] on account of their triumph.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir-e-kaar kuch logon ne kaha ke “yeh dono to mehaz jaadugar hain.Inka maqsad yeh hai ke apne jaadu ke zoar se tumko tumhari zameen se be-dakhal kardein aur tumhare misaali (ideal) tareeq-e-zindagi ka khatma kardein

verses.uthmani: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَاَجۡمِعُوۡا كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ائۡتُوۡا صَفًّا ۚ وَقَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ الۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ اسۡتَعۡلٰى
verses.transliteration: faajmi'oo kaydakum thumma itoo <u>s</u>affan waqad afla<u>h</u>a alyawma mani ista'l<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
verses.khattab: So orchestrate your plan, then come forward in ˹perfect˺ ranks. And whoever prevails today will certainly be successful.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So summon up your guile, in the way of sorcery (read fa’jma‘ū, from [the first form] jama‘a, meaning ‘he gathered’, or read fa-ajmi‘ū, from [the fourth form] ajma‘a, meaning ‘he resolved [to do something]’) and come in battle-line (saffan, a circumstantial qualifier, meaning ‘standing in rows’). For truly he who is uppermost, [he who] triumphs, this day shall be the victor!’
verses.romanUrdu: Apni saari tadberein aaj ikatthi karlo aur eka karke maidan mein aao. Bas yeh samajhlo ke aaj jo gaalib raha wahi jeet gaya.”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا يٰمُوۡسٰٓى اِمَّاۤ اَنۡ تُلۡقِىَ وَاِمَّاۤ اَنۡ نَّكُوۡنَ اَوَّلَ مَنۡ اَلۡقٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>loo y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u> imm<u>a</u> an tulqiya waimm<u>a</u> an nakoona awwala man alq<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
verses.khattab: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or let us be the first to cast.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘O Moses, you choose: either cast, your staff first, or we shall be the first to cast’, their staff.
verses.romanUrdu: Jaadugar bole “Moosa, tum phenkte ho ya pehle hum phenkein?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ بَلۡ اَلۡقُوۡا ۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ سِحۡرِهِمۡ اَنَّهَا تَسۡعٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la bal alqoo fai<u>tha</u> <u>h</u>ib<u>a</u>luhum wa'i<u>s</u>iyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min si<u>h</u>rihim annah<u>a</u> tas'<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
verses.khattab: Moses responded, “No, you go first.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him—by their magic—to be slithering
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Nay, you cast!’, and so they cast, and lo! their ropes and their staffs (‘isiyyihim: derives from ‘isūwwun, but the two wāw [letters] have been changed into two yā’ [letters], with the kasra vowelling applied to both the ‘ayn and the sād) appeared to him by [the effect of] their sorcery as though they were, snakes, gliding swiftly, on their bellies.
verses.romanUrdu: Moosa ne kaha “nahin, tumhi phenko” yakayak unki rassiyan aur unki laathiyan unke jaadu ke zoar se Moosa ko daudti hui mehsoos hone lagi

verses.uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَاَوۡجَسَ فِىۡ نَفۡسِهٖ خِيۡفَةً مُّوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
verses.khattab: So Moses concealed fear within himself
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Moses sensed fear within himself, that is to say, he feared that if [the effect of] their sorcery was of the same kind as his miracle, he would become suspect in people’s minds and they would not believe in him.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur moosa apne dil mein darr gaya

verses.uthmani: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.indopak: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡاَعۡلٰى
verses.transliteration: quln<u>a</u> l<u>a</u> takhaf innaka anta ala'l<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
verses.khattab: We reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear! It is certainly you who will prevail
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We said, to him, ‘Do not be afraid! Indeed you shall have the upper hand, over them by triumphing.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne kaha “mat darr, tu hi galib rahega

verses.uthmani: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَاَ لۡقِ مَا فِىۡ يَمِيۡنِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوۡا ؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوۡا كَيۡدُ سٰحِرٍ ؕ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ السّٰحِرُ حَيۡثُ اَتٰى
verses.transliteration: waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sana'oo innama sana'oo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata
verses.saheeh: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
verses.khattab: Cast what is in your right hand, and it will swallow up what they have made, for what they have made is no more than a magic trick. And magicians can never succeed wherever they go.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And cast that which is in your right hand — and this was his staff. It shall swallow up that which they have produced. For what they have produced is only a sorcerer’s trick, that is to say, a kind thereof, and the sorcerer does not succeed wherever he may go’, in his sorcery. So Moses cast his staff and it swallowed up all of that which they [had] produced.
verses.romanUrdu: Phenk jo kuch tere haath mein hai, abhi inki saari banawati cheezon ko ningle (swallow) jata hai, yeh jo kuch bana kar laye hain yeh to jaadugar ka fareb hai, aur jaadugar kabhi kamiyab nahin ho sakta, khwah kisi shaan se woh aaye”

verses.uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: فَاُلۡقِىَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوۡۤا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوۡنَ وَمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa
verses.saheeh: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verses.khattab: So the magicians fell down in prostration, declaring, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thereat the sorcerers cast [their heads] down prostrating, they fell down prostrating to God, exalted be He: They said, ‘We [now] believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir ko yahi hua ke saarey jaadugar sajde mein gira diye gaye aur pukar utthey “ maan liya humne Haroon aur Moosa ke Rubb ko”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَـكُمۡ ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَـكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِىۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَ ۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُصَلِّبَـنَّكُمۡ فِىۡ جُذُوۡعِ النَّخۡلِ وَلَـتَعۡلَمُنَّ اَيُّنَاۤ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّاَبۡقٰى
verses.transliteration: qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee 'allamakumu alssihra falaoqatti'anna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthoo'i alnnakhli walata'lamunna ayyuna ashaddu 'athaban waabqa
verses.saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
verses.khattab: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will really see whose punishment is more severe and more lasting.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Said he, Pharaoh, ‘Do you profess belief (read a-āmantum pronouncing both hamzas, or with the second changed to an alif) in him before I, myself, give you permission? He is indeed your chief, your teacher, who taught you sorcery. I shall assuredly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides (min khilāfin, a circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘alternate [hands and feet]’, in other words, the right hands and the left feet) and I shall assuredly crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. And you shall then know which of us — meaning himself and the Lord of Moses — is harsher in [inflicting] chastisement, and [which of us is] more lasting’, more enduring in [sustaining] opposition to him [Moses].
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne kaha “tum iman le aaye qabl iske ke main tumhein iski ijazat deta? Maloom ho gaya ke yeh tumhara guru hai jisne tumhein jaadugari sikhayi thi. Accha ab main tumhare haath paon mukhalif simton (alternate sides ) se katwata hoon aur khajoor ke tano(trunks) par tumko sooli deta hoon, phir tumhein pata chal jayega ke hum dono mein se kiska azaab zyada sakht aur dair pa hai” (yani main tumhein zyada sakht saza de sakta hoon ya Moosa)

wbw.translation: So surely I will cut off
and surely I will crucify you

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا لَنۡ نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلٰى مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنَا فَاقۡضِ مَاۤ اَنۡتَ قَاضٍ ؕ اِنَّمَا تَقۡضِىۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا ؕ
verses.transliteration: qaloo lan nuthiraka 'ala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya
verses.saheeh: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
verses.khattab: They responded, “By the One Who created us! We will never prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us. So do whatever you want! Your authority only covers the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They said, ‘We will not choose you over what has come to us of clear signs, proving the truthfulness of Moses, and [over] Him Who originated us, created us (wa’lladhī fatarana, either an oath, or a supplement to [the preceding] mā, ‘what’). Decree what you will decree, that is, do what you say. What you decree is only [relevant] in the life of this world (al-hayāta’l-dunyā, is in the accusative because the scope [of his decree] is being indicated, in other words ‘[you can only decree] in it’); yet you will be requited for it in the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Jaadugaron (magicians) ne jawab diya “qasam hai us zaat ki jisne humein paida kiya hai, yeh hargiz nahin ho sakta ke hum roshan nishaniyan samne aa janey ke baad bhi (sadaqat par) tujhey tarjeeh dein. Tu jo kuch karna chahey karle, tu zyada se zyada bas isi duniya ki zindagi ka faisla kar sakta hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَـغۡفِرَ لَـنَا خَطٰيٰنَا وَمَاۤ اَكۡرَهۡتَـنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ السِّحۡرِ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰى
verses.transliteration: inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana 'alayhi mina alssihri waallahu khayrun waabqa
verses.saheeh: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
verses.khattab: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord so He may forgive our sins and that magic you have forced us to practice. And Allah is far superior ˹in reward˺ and more lasting ˹in punishment˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We profess belief in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, in the way of ascribing partners [to God] and otherwise, and the sorcery to which you forced us, to learn and to perform in order to oppose Moses. And God is better, than you in rewarding if he is obeyed, and more enduring’, than you in chastisement if he is disobeyed.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum to apne Rubb par iman le aaye taa-ke woh hamari khatayein maaf karde, aur is jaadugari se jispar tu nay humein majboor kiya tha darguzar farmaye. Allah hi accha hai aur wahi baaqi rehne waala hai”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهٗ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجۡرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَـنَّمَ ۚ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَ لَا يَحۡيٰى
verses.transliteration: innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama l<u>a</u> yamootu feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ya<u>h</u>y<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
verses.khattab: Whoever comes to their Lord as an evildoer will certainly have Hell, where they can neither live nor die
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Truly whoever comes to his Lord a criminal, a disbeliever, like Pharaoh, for him there shall be Hell wherein he shall neither die, and thus find rest, nor live, a life of any benefit to him.
verses.romanUrdu: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo mujrin bankar apne Rubb ke huzoor haazir hoga uske liye jahannum hai jismein woh na jiyega na marega

verses.uthmani: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِهٖ مُؤۡمِنًا قَدۡ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الۡعُلٰى ۙ
verses.transliteration: waman yatihi muminan qad 'amila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu al'ula
verses.saheeh: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
verses.khattab: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done good, they will have the highest ranks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And whoever comes to Him a believer, having performed righteous deeds — the obligatory and supererogatory deeds, for such shall be the highest degrees (al-‘ulā, the plural of ‘ulyā, the feminine form of a‘lā) —
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jo uske huzoor momin ki haisiyat se haazir hoga, jisne neik amal kiye hongey, aisey sab logon ke liye buland darje hain

verses.uthmani: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.indopak: جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا ؕ وَذٰ لِكَ جَزَآءُ مَنۡ تَزَكّٰى
verses.transliteration: jann<u>a</u>tu '<u>a</u>dnin tajree min ta<u>h</u>tih<u>a</u> alanh<u>a</u>ru kh<u>a</u>lideena feeh<u>a</u> wa<u>tha</u>lika jaz<u>a</u>o man tazakk<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
verses.khattab: the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. That is the reward of those who purify themselves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the Gardens of Eden, that is to say, as a [place of] residence (this [jannātu ‘Adnin, ‘Gardens of Eden’] is an explication thereof [of al-darajātu’l-‘ulā, ‘the highest degrees’]) underneath which rivers flow, abiding therein, and that is the reward of him who keeps pure, of sins.
verses.romanUrdu: Sada bahaar baagh (gardens) hain jinke nichey nehrein beh rahi hongi Un mein woh hamesha rahenge.yeh jaza hai us shaks ki jo pakeezgi ikhtiyar karey

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوۡسٰٓى ۙ اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِىۡ فَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيۡقًا فِى الۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسًا ۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّلَا تَخۡشٰى
verses.transliteration: walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri bi'ibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha
verses.saheeh: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
verses.khattab: And We surely inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants ˹at night˺ and strike a dry passage for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be concerned ˹of drowning˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We revealed to Moses, [saying], ‘Lead My servants on a journey by night (read as an asri, ‘that: lead on a journey by night’, from [fourth form] asrā, ‘he travelled by night’; or read as an’isri, from [first form] sarā, ‘he travelled by night’, both being alternative forms), in other words, travel with them by night from the land of Egypt, and strike for them, make for them, by striking your staff, a dry path in the sea. So he fulfilled what he had been commanded, and God made the ground dry so that they were able to pass through it. Do not fear to be overtaken, that is, [fearing] that Pharaoh might catch you, and do not be afraid’, of drowning.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Moosa par wahee ki ke ab raat-o-raat mere bandon ko lekar chal padh, aur unke liye samandar mein sukhi sadak (dry path) bana le, tujhe kisi ke taaqub ka zara khauf na ho aur na (samandar ke beech se guzarte huey) darr lagey

verses.uthmani: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.indopak: فَاَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُوۡدِهٖ فَغَشِيَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ ؕ
verses.transliteration: faatba'ahum fir'awnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi m<u>a</u> ghashiyahum
verses.saheeh: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
verses.khattab: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers—but how overwhelming were the waters that submerged them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then Pharaoh pursued them with his hosts, with him [Pharaoh] alongside them, and there engulfed them what did engulf them of the sea, and it drowned them.
verses.romanUrdu: Peechey se Frioun apne laskhar lekar pahucha aur phir samandar unpar chaa gaya jaisa ke chaa jaane ka haqq tha

verses.uthmani: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَاَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهٗ وَمَا هَدٰى
verses.transliteration: waa<u>d</u>alla fir'awnu qawmahu wam<u>a</u> had<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
verses.khattab: And ˹so˺ Pharaoh led his people astray, and did not guide ˹them rightly˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Pharaoh led his people astray, by calling them to worship him, and he did not guide them, nay he led them to destruction, in contrast to what he said [to them], and I guide you only to the path of rectitude [Q. 40:29].
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun ne apni qaum ko gumraah hi kiya tha, koi saheeh rehnumayi nahin ki thi

verses.uthmani: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.indopak: يٰبَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ قَدۡ اَنۡجَيۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوٰعَدۡنٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَنَّ وَالسَّلۡوٰى
verses.transliteration: ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min 'aduwwikum wawa'adnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna 'alaykumu almanna waalssalwa
verses.saheeh: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
verses.khattab: O Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you on the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and sent down to you manna and quails
verses.jalalayn: ﻿O Children of Israel, truly We delivered you from your enemy, Pharaoh, by drowning him, and We made a tryst with you on the right side of the [Tūr] Mount, in order to give Moses the Torah, that it may be implemented it [by you], and We sent down to you manna and quails, namely, turunjabīn [citrus fruit] and the quail. The ones being addressed in the vocative [by ‘O Children of Israel’] are those Jews living at the time of the Prophet (s), and they are addressed with reference to the graces which God bestowed on their forefathers at the time of the prophet Moses as a preface to what God [now] says to them:
verses.romanUrdu: Aey bani Israel, humne tumko tumhare dushman se najaat di, aur Tur ke dayein jaanib tumhari haazri ke liye waqt muqarrar kiya aur tumpar manna o salwa (quails) utara

wbw.translation: and We made a covenant with you

verses.uthmani: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.indopak: كُلُوۡا مِنۡ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡا فِيۡهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِىۡ ۚ وَمَنۡ يَّحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِىۡ فَقَدۡ هَوٰى
verses.transliteration: kuloo min <u>t</u>ayyib<u>a</u>ti m<u>a</u> razaqn<u>a</u>kum wal<u>a</u> ta<u>t</u>ghaw feehi faya<u>h</u>illa 'alaykum gha<u>d</u>abee waman ya<u>h</u>lil 'alayhi gha<u>d</u>abee faqad haw<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
verses.khattab: ˹saying,˺ “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not transgress in them, or My wrath will befall you. And whoever My wrath befalls is certainly doomed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Eat of the good things We have provided you, that is to say, of that which has been bestowed on you as a grace [from God], but do not transgress regarding it, by being ungrateful for the grace thereof, lest My wrath descend on you ([if read] fa-yahilla, it means ‘[lest] it [My wrath] become incumbent [upon you]’; or [if read] fa-yuhilla, it means ‘[lest] it descend [on you]’). And he on whom My wrath descends (read yahlil, ‘becomes incumbent’, or yahlul, ‘descends’) certainly perishes, falls into the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Khao hamara diya hua paak rizq aur isey kha kar sarkashi na karo warna tumpar mera gazab toot padega. Aur jispar mera gazab toota woh phir gir kar hi raha

verses.uthmani: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَاِنِّىۡ لَـغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا ثُمَّ اهۡتَدٰى
verses.transliteration: wainnee laghaff<u>a</u>run liman t<u>a</u>ba wa<u>a</u>mana wa'amila <u>sa</u>li<u>h</u>an thumma ihtad<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
verses.khattab: But I am truly Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, and does good, then persists on ˹true˺ guidance.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed I am Forgiving toward him who repents, from ascribing partners [to God], and believes, affirms God’s Oneness, and acts righteously, is sincere in [performing] the obligatory and the supererogatory [deeds], and then follows guidance’, by adhering to what has been mentioned up to his death.
verses.romanUrdu: Albatta jo tawba karle aur iman laye aur neik amal karey, phir seedha chalta rahey, uske liye main bahut darguzar karne wala hoon

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَعۡجَلَكَ عَنۡ قَوۡمِكَ يٰمُوۡسٰى
verses.transliteration: wam<u>a</u> a'jalaka 'an qawmika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
verses.khattab: ˹Allah asked,˺ “Why have you come with such haste ahead of your people, O Moses?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘And what has hurried you [to depart] from your people, in order to come to the appointed time to receive the Torah, O Moses?’
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kya cheez tumhein apni qaum se pehle le aayi Moosa

verses.uthmani: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.indopak: قَالَ هُمۡ اُولَاۤءِ عَلٰٓى اَثَرِىۡ وَ عَجِلۡتُ اِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضٰى
verses.transliteration: q<u>a</u>la hum ol<u>a</u>i 'al<u>a</u> atharee wa'ajiltu ilayka rabbi litar<u>da</u>
verses.saheeh: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
verses.khattab: He replied, “They are close on my tracks. And I have hastened to You, my Lord, so You will be pleased.”
